body:
## Destination

Windmill generates DNA in production with the strategy chosen in [Choose the fingerprinting strategy](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/33): Qwen3.8 Flash as primary model and Qwen3.7 Flash as fallback model via OpenRouter, tiered by title popularity, with bounded retries, a spend pause on provider limits, and the recorded acceptance criteria met on the ten benchmark titles.

## Notes

- Execution exception: this map carries implementation. Its tickets are build slices and the decisions they expose, not only decisions.
- Source of truth for the strategy: the resolution comment on [Choose the fingerprinting strategy](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/33) and the parent research map [Optimize Windmill fingerprint quality and cost](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/27). Do not re-decide what those settle; open a ticket here if implementation contradicts them.
- Glossary: `CONTEXT.md` at the repo root (fingerprint, premium tier, economy tier, primary model, fallback model, completeness queue, soft reset, spend pause).
- Entry points: `goodwatch-flows/windmill/f/dna/generate/fetch.py`, `next.py`, `iterate.py`, `vectors.py`, `f/dna/models.py`, and the flows `f/dna/generate_dna.flow` and `f/dna/crawl_all_by_id.flow`.
- Budget: OpenRouter key limits of $1 per day and $30 per month. The acceptance run must stay under $0.05. Agree on any other paid inference before running it.
- Use the tdd skill for code changes and code-review before merging. Use wizard for steps only the owner can perform (keys, limits, Windmill variables).
- GitHub native sub-issues and blocking dependencies define the frontier. Claim a ticket by assigning it before work.

## Decisions so far

<!-- Add a named ticket link and one-line gist only after resolution. -->

- [Provision the OpenRouter key and Windmill variable](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/36#issuecomment-5660483414): Provisioned the Windmill secret with an API-verified $1 daily key limit and owner-confirmed $30 monthly guardrail and Alibaba access.

- [Replace the Gemini generation client with the tiered OpenRouter client](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/37#issuecomment-5661407712): Implemented and reviewed tiered OpenRouter generation with bounded retries and ID-preserving partial results; generation client merged; spend-pause integration is tracked separately.

- [Add the spend pause to the generation flow](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/38#issuecomment-5662510380): Implemented, reviewed and deployed daily/monthly spend pauses, concurrent-worker handling and empty-flow coverage.

- [Run the acceptance criteria on the ten benchmark titles](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/39#issuecomment-5667510589): Functional acceptance completed, invalid highlights repaired and regenerated, actual monthly rejection verified; owner waived exact reconciliation of missing cost metadata.

- [Run F/D repeat runs and measure embedding cost](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/40#issuecomment-5669967997): Completed ten-title repeats for both models, documented semantic/highlight drift, and measured the embedding baseline; total budget accounting $0.01864.

- [Enable the DNA generation schedule after fingerprint-only rollout](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/43#issuecomment-5671525742): Schedule remains enabled; first scheduled run generated and persisted 100 independently verified fingerprints, text vectors remain absent, and ineffective priority DNA gating was removed and deployed.

## Not yet specified

- None currently identified; all implementation-map children are resolved.

## Out of scope

- Further essence-text embedding research or rollout. The owner retired text embedding vectors on 2026-09-14; essence text remains part of DNA. Historical embedding-cost evidence is retained, but does not create follow-up work. See [Enable the DNA generation schedule after fingerprint-only rollout](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/43).

- A soft reset of already-fingerprinted titles. Owner decided on 2026-09-12 not to clear selection timestamps; the completeness queue stays as is.
- Switching from OpenRouter to direct Alibaba Model Studio. About 5% to 30% cheaper on list price, but untested; a later cost optimization.
- General recommendation-system redesign.

comments.body:
Closing as completed after reviewing the full implementation map, its native sub-issues and resolution comments, and current production operation.

All six children are closed as completed:
- [#36: provisioning and limits](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/36#issuecomment-5660483414)
- [#37: tiered OpenRouter generation client](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/37#issuecomment-5661407712)
- [#38: deployed spend pauses](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/38#issuecomment-5663155970)
- [#39: ten-title functional acceptance](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/39#issuecomment-5667510589)
- [#40: repeat validation and documented drift](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/40#issuecomment-5669967997)
- [#43: enabled production schedule and independently verified fingerprints](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/43#issuecomment-5671525742)

A fresh read-only Windmill check on September 15 confirms `f/dna/generate_dna` is enabled (`0 5 */3 * * *`, Europe/Berlin). The three latest completed runs, started at 04:05, 07:05 and 10:05 UTC, succeeded and each reported `fingerprints_count: 100`. Latest run: `01a0a3e2-1e27-c73b-553f-ce1a2308e873`. No additional inference was triggered for this closure check.

Acceptance retains the recorded qualifications: exact missing-cost reconciliation was explicitly waived by the owner; semantic drift is documented rather than absent; benchmark preview execution and subsequent scheduled production verification are distinct evidence. Text vectors were explicitly retired and are not outstanding work.

[#50](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/50) separately tracks provider freshness recovery and the preexisting missing canonical movie 658039 fingerprint point. Catalog-wide completeness/regeneration was not this implementation map's acceptance requirement, so that follow-up does not block closure.
